name: Composite Refactoring Sequence #1: Extract + Move Methods
description: Real-world example from Guava project: 13 refactorings in sequence (10 Move Method + 3 Move And Rename Method)

smells.description: Class has too many responsibilities (testing multiple scheduler variants)
testBig() method is 150+ lines, handles multiple test scenarios
Similar test setup code repeated across testFixedDelaySchedule and testFixedRateSchedule
testCustomScheduler methods extensively use AbstractIdleService functionality
Common failure testing logic should be extracted
testStart_failed has 5+ parameters for various failure scenarios

refactoring_sequence: Move testCustomSchedulerFailure to new ServiceFailureTest class
Move testBig to new SchedulerStressTest class
Extract common setup into helper methods
